description: Compare the file 'config/database.py' between Git branches 'main' and 'feature-auth' using VSCode's Source Control features. Open the Source Control panel (Ctrl+Shift+G or click the Source Control icon), then use Git comparison features to view differences. You can use Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P) and search for 'Git: Compare References' or click the branch name in the status bar (bottom-left) and look for comparison options. Select 'main' as the base branch and 'feature-auth' as the compare branch, then locate and open 'config/database.py' from the changes list to see the diff view.
